title: Dog at Outdoor Concert
description: A black and brown dog with a tag collar sits in the foreground looking at the viewer surrounded by pink flowers and a large crowd of people. Behind them is a stone archway framing a stage with a city skyline and a large yellow sun setting in an orange sky.
prompt: A black and brown dog with a collar and tag sits in the foreground looking forward surrounded by pink flowers and a large crowd of people facing away. Behind the crowd is a large stone archway framing an outdoor stage with a city skyline and a big yellow sun setting in a bright orange and red sky with teal above. The painting uses bold colors and visible brush strokes.
